outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic of breast anatomy plus a classification table listing subtype frequencies; no averaged plot data is shown that would require individual data points.
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the study's conceptual framework (circadian phenotypes and their relationship to drug sensitivity/tumor growth); no quantitative plot is present.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the luciferase recording method; no data plot is shown.
Panel D shows illustrative line traces of oscillatory signals for representative models, a plot type exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel E is a correlation heatmap, a plot type exempt from needing individual data points overlaid.
Panel F contains a schematic plus an example line plot of cell number over days for representative models; line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Panel G contains a schematic plus an example dose-response line plot; line plots are exempt from needing individual data points.
Panel H shows a schematic plus gene expression and mutation heatmaps, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel I shows scatter plots (PCA cluster plot and 3D parameter scatter plot); scatter plots inherently display individual data points, so no overlay is required.
